text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer. The breeze feels fresh this morning, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: It seems like you made the most of your day off.
It seems like you made the most of your day off.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I did. I hiked a mountain yesterday and spent my day listening to all the voices of nature.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I heard the leaves rustling and the birds singing, and smelled the scent of the earth as the wind carried it along.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I felt as if I could have stayed there on the side of that mountain forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the notion of her staying in the wilderness "forever" is somewhat troubling, I'm glad to hear that Yamanin Zephyr had a relaxing day off.
